task.instruction: Find a hotel in Ohio From December 20th to December 23th for 3 adults and 2 rooms.

final_answer:
I searched Booking.com for Ohio, Dec 20–23, 2026 (3 nights), 3 adults, 2 rooms. The search returned 2,821 properties; these are the strongest options where two rooms are actually available for your group (prices are totals for all 3 nights, before taxes/fees unless noted):

**Best value**
- **Berlin Encore Hotel & Suites** — Berlin, 9.3 "Wonderful" (550 reviews), Location 9.6. 2× Deluxe King Room, breakfast included, free cancellation. **US$684 + US$89 taxes and fees**.
- **Holiday Inn Columbus Dwtn-Capitol Square by IHG** — Downtown Columbus, 7.7 "Good" (586 reviews). 2× Standard King Room, free cancellation, no prepayment needed. **US$694 + US$125 taxes and fees**.
- **Home2 Suites Troy, OH** — Troy, 8.5 "Very Good" (86 reviews). 2× Studio Suite with Two Queen Beds, breakfast included, free cancellation, no prepayment. **US$814 + US$106 taxes and fees**.

**Best reviewed**
- **Hyatt Regency Columbus** — Downtown Columbus, 9.1 "Wonderful" (422 reviews), Location 9.5. 2× King Room, free cancellation, no prepayment. **US$900 + US$162 taxes and fees**.
- **Hyatt Place Columbus/OSU** — Columbus, 9.1 "Wonderful" (660 reviews), Location 9.5. 2× King Room with Sofa Bed, breakfast included. **US$906 + US$163 taxes and fees**.
- **Riverbend Hotel and Suites, Trademark Collection by Wyndham** — Ashtabula, 9.2 "Wonderful" (224 reviews), Location 9.5. 2× Queen Room with Two Queen Beds, free cancellation, no prepayment (rate shown without a base price, +US$91 taxes).

**Also worth a look**
- **Cherry Valley Hotel** — Newark, 8.2 "Very Good" (687 reviews). 2× King Room with Sofabed and Tub, free cancellation, no prepayment. **US$894 + US$118 taxes and fees**.
- **La Quinta by Wyndham Mansfield OH** — Mansfield, 8.1 "Very Good" (517 reviews). 2× Double Room, breakfast included, free cancellation, no prepayment.
- **Marriott at the University of Dayton** — Dayton, 8.9 "Excellent" (140 reviews), Location 9.3. Note: the US$402.30 (+US$66 taxes) rate is for **one** King or Queen Room (1 king bed, max 4 people, free cancellation until Dec 18, pay at property); a second room roughly doubles it. A non-refundable Queen Room is US$357 per room, so 2 rooms = US$714 + taxes.

If you tell me which city you're aiming for (Columbus, Cleveland, Cincinnati, Dayton…) or a nightly budget, I can narrow this down and pull the exact room-by-room availability for that property.

judge.rationale: The agent searched Booking.com for Ohio with Dec 20–23, 2026, 3 adults, 2 rooms, and provided supported hotel options/prices from the site.
